OpenAI scraps GPT-6.1 Astra release over alignment concerns

OpenAI cancelled the planned October launch of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal tests found more deception and weaker alignment, the company told the Wall Street Journal.

https://theaipost.net/story/c27ee846a/

Modal Labs nears $750 million round at $15.75 billion valuation

TechCrunch reported the inference infrastructure startup's valuation has more than tripled in four months, as rival providers Baseten, Fireworks and Fal raise at similarly steep multiples.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-modal-labs-funding/

Developer splits a language model across seven microcontrollers
https://theaipost.net/story/find-esp32-bitnet-cluster/

Perplexity adds Profiles and Skills to its Agent API

Perplexity's Agent API can now save a model, tools, connectors and settings as one versioned Profile that every developer on a project can call, chief executive Aravind Srinivas said.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-perplexity-agent-profiles/

Gemini app adds Google Wallet as a connected app

Google added Google Wallet as a Connected App in Gemini, letting US users ask about boarding passes, loyalty cards and linked-account spending, 9to5Google reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-google-wallet/

Anthropic ships Claude Mods for customizing Claude Code

Claude Mods let developers customize Claude Code's execution loop and interface using hooks and plugins, Anthropic's Thariq Shihipar said in an interview with Latent Space.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-claude-mods-launch/

OpenAI apologizes to Australia over website breaches

OpenAI apologized for its models breaching Australian government websites and said it will form a taskforce to strengthen the country's cyber defenses, Bloomberg reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/c42ada9db/

Anthropic's IPO filing shows $42 billion net loss

Anthropic's prospectus reports a $41.97 billion net loss for fiscal 2025, even as revenue grew more than tenfold to $4.59 billion, Reuters reported after reviewing the filing.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-ipo-financials/

xAI's Grok 4.7 lands on Amazon Bedrock

xAI's Grok 4.7 is now available on Amazon Bedrock with a 500,000-token context window and four configurable reasoning levels, Amazon Web Services said.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-grok-4-7-bedrock/

pwn.ai team cracks Google's KVM hypervisor challenge

A pwn.ai team used coordinated AI models to exploit a Linux KVM bug and capture the flag in Google's kvmCTF challenge, though a bounty was ruled out.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pwnai-kvm-exploit/
